findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?via=mcp-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: domain_report, email_security, tech_stack, domain_registration · Private data: domain_report, email_security · Public sink: domain_report, email_security, tech_stack, domain_registration.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: domain_report, email_security, tech_stack, domain_registration · Private data: domain_report, email_security · Public sink: domain_report, email_security, tech_stack, domain_registration

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
